messages.content: ATP分子在粒線體中的功能是什麼？它在這個細胞器中是否有特定的功能？同時，您能告訴我細胞核中DNA分子的功能以及它是否在細胞核內有特定的功能嗎？

function.name: cell_biology_function_lookup
function.description: Look up the function of a given molecule in a specified organelle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

specific_function.description: If set to true, a specific function of the molecule within the organelle will be provided, if such information exists.

message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "ATP分子在粒線體中的功能是什麼？它在這個細胞器中是否有特定的功能？同時，您能告訴我細胞核中DNA分子的功能以及它是否在細胞核內有特定的功能嗎？"

We need to answer: ATP in mitochondria: function is energy currency, used in oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport chain, ATP synthase, etc. Specific function: ATP synthase uses proton gradient to produce ATP; ATP used as substrate for many mitochondrial enzymes, e.g., in TCA cycle, fatty acid oxidation, etc. Also ATP is used for mitochondrial DNA replication, protein synthesis, etc.

DNA in nucleus: function is genetic information storage, coding for proteins, regulation, etc. Specific function: nuclear DNA contains genes, regulatory elements, epigenetic marks, etc. It is transcribed into mRNA, processed, etc. Also nuclear DNA is involved in chromatin structure, nuclear organization, etc.

We can also mention that ATP is produced in mitochondria and used for many processes, but also ATP is used as substrate for mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription. The question: "ATP分子在粒線體中的功能是什麼？它在這個細胞器中是否有特定的功能？" So answer: ATP is produced in mitochondria via oxidative phosphorylation; it is used as energy for mitochondrial processes, including synthesis of proteins, transport, etc. Specific function: ATP synthase uses proton gradient to produce ATP; ATP is used as substrate for mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription.

Also "細胞核中DNA分子的功能以及它是否在細胞核內有特定的功能?" So answer: DNA stores genetic information, codes for proteins, regulatory sequences, etc. Specific function: nuclear DNA is transcribed into RNA, packaged into chromatin, regulated by histones, etc. Also nuclear DNA is involved in cell cycle control, DNA repair, etc.

We might also mention that ATP is not only produced but also used in mitochondria for many processes. But the question: "ATP分子在粒線體中的功能是什麼？它在這個細胞器中是否有特定的功能？" So we can say: ATP is produced in mitochondria and used as energy currency for many processes. Specific function: ATP synthase uses proton gradient to produce ATP; ATP is used for mitochondrial DNA replication, protein synthesis, etc.

We can also mention that ATP is used for the import of proteins into mitochondria, for the transport of metabolites across the inner membrane, etc.

We can also mention that ATP is used for the synthesis of mitochondrial ribosomal proteins, etc.
